title: Invoice Delivery Options, Paper Invoice Fees and Dormancy Periods — Commercial Credit Account
content:
Invoice delivery options of a Commercial Credit Account depend on its terms tier:

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee per invoice mailed on paper, USD | 3.00 | 3.00 | 2.50 | 2.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Monthly consolidated invoicing available | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| EDI 810 invoicing available | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Whole months without a posted invoice before a zero-balance active account closes as dormant | 18 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 36 | 36 |

- **Paper invoice fee** — fee per invoice mailed on paper when the account elects paper delivery.
- **Consolidated billing** — whether the account may elect monthly consolidated invoicing (one invoice per calendar month).
- **EDI** — whether the account may receive invoices by EDI 810.
- **Dormancy** — whole months without any posted invoice after which an active account with zero balance is closed as dormant.

*Points of judgement:* the Corbett Net 60 Corporate and Net 90 Strategic tiers carry a paper invoice fee of 0.00; monthly consolidated invoicing starts at the Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account and EDI at the Corbett Net 45 Business Account.
